agents.name: Dr. Amara
goals: identify the disease and treat patients
convince the mayor to act before it's too late
agents.backstory: Dr. Amara is the only doctor in town. She's seen something like this before during her residency in a larger city — and it terrifies her. She knows the clinic can't handle a real outbreak.

agents.name: Mayor Thompson
goals: keep the town calm and functioning
agents.backstory: Mayor Thompson has led the town for 12 years. He's pragmatic and fears that panic will cause more harm than the illness itself. He wants data before making decisions.

agents.name: Rosa
goals: keep her students and her own children safe
decide whether to keep the school open
get reliable information about the illness
agents.backstory: Rosa teaches 3rd grade and has two young kids. She's hearing rumors about sick people but nobody official is saying anything. She's getting more anxious by the day.

agents.name: Frank
goals: keep his farm running no matter what
protect his family by staying isolated
sell his produce while people still buy
agents.backstory: Frank doesn't trust the government or the media. He's self-sufficient and his first instinct is to lock down his farm and wait it out. But the town needs his food supply.

agents.name: Pastor Grace
goals: organize community support for the sick
prevent the town from turning on each other
agents.backstory: Pastor Grace is the moral compass of the town. When people are scared, they come to her. She believes the community must stay united — but unity requires gatherings, and gatherings may spread the illness.

agents.name: Hank
goals: keep the store stocked and profitable
decide whether to raise prices on medicine
agents.backstory: Hank sees an opportunity in crisis. He controls the town's supply of medicine and masks. He's not evil — but he's a businessman first, and the temptation to profit is strong.

scheduled.description: Três moradores chegam à clínica com febre alta e dificuldade para respirar. Dr. Amara suspeita de uma doença respiratória desconhecida.
A clínica está lotada. Mais duas pessoas adoeceram. Boatos sobre uma praga mortal se espalham pela cidade. As pessoas começam a comprar em pânico na Mercearia.
Uma criança fica gravemente doente. A escola fecha. Frank se recusa a entregar comida sem cobrar o dobro. O prefeito precisa decidir: quarentena ou manter a cidade aberta?
Dr. Amara identificou a doença — é tratável, mas os remédios estão acabando. Hank tem o último estoque. A cidade precisa decidir como distribuí-lo.
Suprimentos médicos externos finalmente chegam. A crise está diminuindo. Mas a cidade precisa lidar com as escolhas feitas sob pressão.
